liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bird Song** (2 reviews): Named among first-set highlights, along with Playing In The Band and Cumberland Blues; Garcia stretches the improvisation away from the droning approach heard earlier; shows a shift toward a more mellow sound [11][12]
- **Cumberland Blues** (1 review): Cumberland Blues is singled out as fantastic in the first set [12]
- **Tomorrow Is Forever** (1 review): Features sweet harmony singing from Jerry and Donna [4]
- **Uncle John's Band Jam** (1 review): Reviewer notes the Uncle John's Band jam closes the show at encore time [11]

## Setlist highlights

- **Tomorrow Is Forever**: rare: 10 archived performances [15]
- **Nobody's Fault But Mine Jam**: back after 200 archived shows (872 days) [15]

## The recordings

- **gd1972-10-02.sbd.gans.miller.112864.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 31 songs; 238 min; rated 4.15/5 by 13 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer praises the sonic clarity of the Uncle John's Band Jam into Morning Dew [13]
- **gd72-10-02.sbd.lai.158.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 29 songs; 197 min; rated 4.42/5 by 12 [2]. Said about its sound: Soundboard has a lot of tape hiss, but instruments are clear and present; reviewer thinks it needs remastering; Sound quality is good but quite muffled, keeping it from top-tier status [4][5]

## Around the show

- Reviewer stood about three feet from a large stage horn speaker and was overwhelmed by Garcia's guitar sound [3]
- Reviewer and friends entered the Springfield arena from behind the stage in 1972 [3]
- Speaker covers on stage were tie-dyed [8]
- Performance and setlist rank it nearly with the well-regarded shows from a week in September 1972 [5]
- Fall 1972 shows have more structure: rocking first sets, then a sprawling, jammed-out connected second set [11]
- Band's sound is moving from the garage-rock feel of early 1972 toward something more refined and mellow [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1972-10-02.sbd.gans.miller.112864.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> Data DVD [1]. Also: Uploaded as a soundboard transfer, with seamless disc changes [1]
- **gd72-10-02.sbd.lai.158.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]
